source_text: Ethically, while both non-voluntary forms challenge consent paradigms, forced circumcision's coercive element—evident in documented cases of trauma and infection from unsterile conditions—elevates it beyond the debated proxy consent in infancy, where outcomes are generally less traumatic due to developmental amnesia and clinical oversight. [8]
